firstPlayerRule: The most recent visitor to a castle goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns run clockwise. Each player plays an action card or passes.
Four-player games use teams seated opposite their partners, but players still take individual turns. The advanced game changes the action cards, not the starting criterion.
